summary: Explains how IKEv1, IKEv2, and IPsec use hash functions and how vulnerable these protocols are to the reduced collision resistance of MD5 and SHA-1. It helps readers judge the practical impact of weaknesses found in those hashes. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Some secret-stamp tools have cracks. This note checks where Internet security systems use those tools and whether the cracks actually let anyone in.

questions: is ipsec affected by md5 and sha-1 collisions
how does ike use hash algorithms
